title: ETAS: An Effect-Typed Language for Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2607.17780v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Agent systems are programs that coordinate language-model queries, tool calls, human approvals, and ordinary computation, yet existing frameworks wire them together as opaque library objects outside compiler analysis. Treating agent systems from a programming-language perspective, we present Etas, an effect-typed language that elevates agents, tools, workflows, and behavioral specifications to first-class, compiler-checked constructs. Crucially, Etas separates escaping effects from persistent effect request summaries: handlers change how an operation is interpreted without erasing its effect request from the summary, while trace specs constrain permitted effect requests and their order. The compiler composes effect request summaries across calls and handlers, discharging satisfied trace specs statically and keeping a residual monitor where dynamic paths remain uncertain. translated_title: ETAS：一种面向智能体系统的效应类型化语言
translated_abstract: 智能体系统是协调语言模型查询、工具调用、人工审批以及普通计算的程序，然而现有框架将这些组件作为编译器分析范围之外的不透明库对象进行连接。我们从编程语言的视角来看待智能体系统，提出了 Etas，这是一种效应类型化语言，它将智能体、工具、工作流和行为规范提升为一等的、由编译器检查的构造。关键之处在于，Etas 将逃逸效应与持久的效应请求摘要分离开来：处理器可以改变操作的解释方式，但不会从摘要中抹除其效应请求，同时轨迹规范约束了允许的效应请求及其顺序。编译器跨调用和处理器组合效应请求摘要，静态地消解已满足的轨迹规范，并在动态路径仍不确定的地方保留一个残余监视器。我们通过终结处理器等形式化了 Core Etas……
tldr: Etas 是一种效应类型化编程语言，它将智能体、工具、工作流和行为规范作为编译器可检查的一等构造，通过分离逃逸效应与持久效应请求摘要，实现轨迹规范的静态消解与运行时残余监控，从而为智能体系统提供语言层面的安全保障。
